text: Web dialogs: no role, no labelling, no focus trap or restore, no Escape

Landed in 4c8f309 (Opus agent). One shared ModalDialog wrapper: role/aria-modal/aria-labelledby on the existing heading, Escape through the same onClose as Cancel (skipped during IME composition), Tab wraps only at the ends, focus into the box on open (an autoFocus field keeps it) and back to the opener on close with a StrictMode guard. The four forms only swapped their two wrapper elements; internals untouched, no new strings, no dependency. Native <dialog> rejected: jsdom cannot test showModal and it would have redone the overlay CSS and the T-272 click rule. 8 tests, 6 mutation groups. Trailer corrected to the plain model name at cherry-pick. Known limits: focusable list ignores CSS-hidden elements (none of the four forms hide controls that way); the page behind is not aria-hidden beyond aria-modal.
